supanet.note: Your own SupaNet workspace endpoint - every workspace is a separate deployment, so there is no shared URL to hardcode. Set SUPANET_MCP_URL to https://<your-workspace-domain>/mcp before starting Grok (run /supanet-connect for help finding it). Auth is OAuth 2.1 + PKCE with dynamic client registration: on first connection Grok opens your workspace's own login page in a browser, you sign in with your workspace email and approve. No API key to paste. Every tool call then runs as that user and Postgres row-level security still applies.
